label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is param: The switch statement in doSomething() assigns param to bar on cases 'A' and 'D', and since guess.charAt(2) evaluates to 'C', the default case is taken which also assigns param to bar. Therefore, the user-provided value from the Referer header reaches the response.getWriter().printf() call as part of the Object array, making it a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input from Referer header is retrieved and URL decoded
doSomething() method processes param and returns it as bar
bar is used in response.getWriter().printf() which is an HTML sink
